briefings.engineering: APAC users can't reach checkout: reachability 4% via fra, packet loss 96% on the sin -> fra transit path since net-118. The origin itself is healthy.
briefings.support: Customers in Asia-Pacific cannot complete checkout. Tell them it is a regional network problem, their carts are saved, and traffic is being rerouted.
briefings.commander: SEV-1 on checkout-api: regional network partition. Team: Zak, Riley, Jordan. A reroute to a healthy region is being sandbox-tested. Your decision: approve the traffic change.
briefings.leadership: Checkout is unavailable for APAC customers (29% of global traffic failing). The platform is healthy; a network reroute will restore access.
